exposure: Planned place of birth (home vs state-licensed, freestanding birth center)
cohort: 10,609 births attended by members of a statewide midwifery professional association in Washington State, meeting eligibility criteria for planned birth center birth
finding: Rates of adverse outcomes for this cohort in a U.S. state with well-established and integrated community midwifery were low overall, and birth outcomes were similar for births planned at home or at a state-licensed, freestanding birth center.
